questions.q: A continuous random variable $X$ has PDF $f(x) = kx(2 - x)$ for $0 \leq x \leq 2$, and $0$ otherwise. Find the value of $k$.
questions.answer: Total probability must equal 1: $\int_0^2 k(2x - x^2) dx = k[x^2 - x^3/3]_0^2 = k(4 - 8/3) = k(4/3) = 1 \Rightarrow k = 3/4$.

questions.q: For the random variable in the previous question ($k = 3/4$), calculate $P(0 \leq X \leq 1)$.
What is the probability that a continuous random variable takes any single exact value, such as $P(X = c)$?
questions.answer: For any continuous distribution, the probability of taking any exact single point is zero ($P(X = c) = \int_c^c f(x) dx = 0$).

questions.q: Given PDF $f(x) = \dfrac{3}{8}x^2$ for $0 \leq x \leq 2$, find the cumulative distribution function $F(x)$ for $0 \leq x \leq 2$.
For the distribution in the previous question, find the median $m$.
Given $F(x) = \dfrac{x^2 - 1}{8}$ for $1 \leq x \leq 3$, find the PDF $f(x)$ on this interval.
questions.answer: The PDF is the derivative of the CDF: $f(x) = F'(x) = \frac{d}{dx}\left[\frac{x^2 - 1}{8}\right] = \frac{2x}{8} = \frac{x}{4}$.

questions.q: Find the expected value $E(X)$ for the PDF $f(x) = 2x$ on $[0, 1]$.
For the distribution $f(x) = 2x$ on $[0, 1]$, calculate the variance $\text{Var}(X)$.
Find the mode of the continuous distribution with PDF $f(x) = 12x^2(1 - x)$ for $0 \leq x \leq 1$.
questions.answer: The mode is where $f(x)$ is maximized: $f'(x) = 24x - 36x^2 = 12x(2 - 3x) = 0 \Rightarrow x = 2/3$.

questions.q: A continuous random variable has PDF $f(x) = cx$ for $0 \leq x < 2$ and $f(x) = c(4 - x)$ for $2 \leq x \leq 4$. Find $c$.
questions.answer: The PDF forms a symmetric triangle with base 4 and height $2c$. Area $= \frac{1}{2}(4)(2c) = 4c = 1 \Rightarrow c = 1/4$.

questions.q: For the symmetric triangular distribution in the previous question, what is $E(X)$?
questions.answer: By symmetry of the PDF about $x = 2$, the expected value must equal the line of symmetry: $E(X) = 2$.
